name: @nexspeak/desktop
description: NexSpeak desktop app: Electron shell around the static web build.
author: Konstantin Späth

scripts.dev: npm run -s build:input-hook && npm run -s build && NEXSPEAK_DEV_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron .
scripts.start: npm run -s build:input-hook && npm run -s build && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run -s build:input-hook && npm run -s build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.test:e2e: npm run -s build:input-hook && npm run -s build && playwright test
